---
title: "Grant Radar"
format:
  dashboard:
    orientation: rows
    scrolling: true
    theme:
      - cosmo
      - theme.scss
---

```{ojs}
//| output: false
notices = {
  try { return await FileAttachment("notices.json").json(); }
  catch (e) { return []; }
}

today = new Date()
cutoff7  = { const d = new Date(today); d.setDate(d.getDate() - 7);  return d; }
cutoff30 = { const d = new Date(today); d.setDate(d.getDate() - 30); return d; }

last7  = notices.filter(n => n.release_date && new Date(n.release_date) >= cutoff7)
last30 = notices.filter(n => n.release_date && new Date(n.release_date) >= cutoff30)

upcomingDeadlines = {
  const out = [];
  for (const n of notices) {
    let kds; try { kds = JSON.parse(n.key_dates_json || "[]"); } catch (e) { kds = []; }
    for (const kd of kds) {
      const d = new Date(kd.date);
      if (isNaN(d) || d < today) continue;
      if (kd.type === "release") continue;
      out.push({date: kd.date, label: kd.label, type: kd.type, notice_id: n.notice_id, title: n.title, url: n.url});
    }
  }
  return out.sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a.date, b.date));
}

actionTypes = ["rescission", "change", "reissue", "rfa", "nofo"]
actionCount30 = last30.filter(n => actionTypes.includes(n.notice_type)).length

icsTouched30 = {
  const s = new Set();
  for (const n of last30) for (const ic of (n.issuing_orgs || [])) s.add(ic);
  return s.size;
}

profile = {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem("grant-radar.profile.v1");
    return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : { ics: [], mechs: [], topics: [], career: "any" };
  } catch (e) { return { ics: [], mechs: [], topics: [], career: "any" }; }
}

function matchScore(n, p) {
  let s = 0;
  for (const ic of (n.issuing_orgs || [])) if (p.ics.includes(ic))    s += 1;
  for (const m  of (n.mechanisms   || [])) if (p.mechs.includes(m))   s += 1;
  for (const t  of (n.topics       || [])) if (p.topics.includes(t))  s += 1;
  if (p.career && p.career !== "any" && (n.career_stages || []).includes(p.career)) s += 0.5;
  return s;
}

profileEmpty = (!profile.ics?.length && !profile.mechs?.length && !profile.topics?.length && (!profile.career || profile.career === "any"))

ranked7 = profileEmpty
  ? last7.map(n => ({...n, _score: 0}))
  : last7.map(n => ({...n, _score: matchScore(n, profile)})).sort((a, b) => d3.descending(a._score, b._score) || d3.descending(a.release_date, b.release_date))

topicCounts = {
  const m = new Map();
  for (const n of last30) for (const t of (n.topics || [])) m.set(t, (m.get(t) || 0) + 1);
  return Array.from(m, ([topic, n]) => ({topic, n})).sort((a, b) => d3.descending(a.n, b.n)).slice(0, 8);
}
icCounts = {
  const m = new Map();
  for (const n of last30) for (const ic of (n.issuing_orgs || [])) m.set(ic, (m.get(ic) || 0) + 1);
  return Array.from(m, ([ic, n]) => ({ic, n})).sort((a, b) => d3.descending(a.n, b.n)).slice(0, 8);
}
weeklyCounts = {
  const buckets = new Map();
  for (const n of notices) {
    if (!n.release_date) continue;
    const d = new Date(n.release_date);
    const mon = new Date(d); mon.setDate(d.getDate() - ((d.getDay() + 6) % 7));
    const key = mon.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    buckets.set(key, (buckets.get(key) || 0) + 1);
  }
  return Array.from(buckets, ([week, n]) => ({week: new Date(week), n})).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a.week, b.week)).slice(-12);
}

upcoming90 = upcomingDeadlines.filter(d => (new Date(d.date) - today) <= 90*86400000)
```

## Row

### Column {width=58%}

::: {.card title="This week, ranked for you"}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
function chipClass(t) { return "gr-chip gr-chip--" + (t || "guide_notice").replace(/\W+/g, "_"); }

function noticeRow(n) {
  const meta = htl.html`<div class="gr-notice__meta">
    <span class="gr-chip gr-chip--id">${n.notice_id}</span>
    <span class="${chipClass(n.notice_type)}">${n.notice_type.replace(/_/g, " ")}</span>
    ${(n.issuing_orgs || []).slice(0, 2).map(ic => htl.html`<span class="gr-chip">${ic.replace(/^National (Institute|Center) of? /, "")}</span>`)}
    ${(n.issuing_orgs || []).length > 2 ? htl.html`<span class="gr-chip">+${n.issuing_orgs.length - 2}</span>` : ""}
    ${n._score > 0 ? htl.html`<span class="gr-chip gr-chip--match">match ${n._score}</span>` : ""}
  </div>`;
  const tldr = n.purpose_tldr
    ? htl.html`<div class="gr-notice__tldr">${n.purpose_tldr}</div>`
    : htl.html`<div class="gr-notice__tldr gr-notice__tldr--pending">TL;DR pending /refresh-tldrs</div>`;
  const foot = htl.html`<div class="gr-notice__foot">
    ${n.release_date}${(n.mechanisms || []).length ? " · " + n.mechanisms.join(", ") : ""}${(n.topics || []).length ? " · " + n.topics.join(", ") : ""}
  </div>`;
  return htl.html`<div class="gr-notice">
    ${meta}
    <div class="gr-notice__title"><a href="${n.url}" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">${n.title}</a></div>
    ${tldr}
    ${foot}
  </div>`;
}

caption = htl.html`<div class="gr-caption">
  ${profileEmpty
    ? htl.html`No profile saved. <a href="profile.html">Set one</a> to re-rank.`
    : htl.html`Ranked against your <a href="profile.html">profile</a>.`}
</div>`

htl.html`<div>${caption}<div class="gr-list">${ranked7.map(noticeRow)}</div></div>`
```

:::

### Column {width=42%}

::: {.card title="Upcoming deadlines"}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
htl.html`<div class="gr-list">${
  upcomingDeadlines.length === 0
    ? htl.html`<em style="color:#94a3b8;">No future deadlines extracted yet.</em>`
    : upcomingDeadlines.slice(0, 30).map(d => htl.html`
        <div class="gr-deadline">
          <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;">
            <span class="gr-deadline__date">${d.date}</span>
            <span class="gr-deadline__type">${d.type || ""}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="gr-deadline__label">${d.label}</div>
          <div class="gr-deadline__ref">
            <a href="${d.url}" target="_blank">${d.notice_id}</a> — ${d.title.length > 90 ? d.title.slice(0, 87) + "…" : d.title}
          </div>
        </div>`)
}</div>`
```

Plot.plot({
  marginLeft: 140,
  height: 260,
  y: { label: null },
  x: { label: "notices", grid: true, ticks: 4 },
  style: { fontSize: "11px" },
  marks: [
    Plot.barX(topicCounts, {
      y: "topic", x: "n", fill: "#1d3557",
      sort: { y: "x", reverse: true }
    }),
    Plot.text(topicCounts, {
      y: "topic", x: "n", text: "n",
      dx: 5, textAnchor: "start", fill: "#1d1d1d", fontWeight: 600
    }),
    Plot.ruleX([0])
  ]
})

Plot.plot({
  height: 260,
  y: { label: "notices / week", grid: true, ticks: 4 },
  x: { label: null, type: "time" },
  style: { fontSize: "11px" },
  marks: [
    Plot.areaY(weeklyCounts, {
      x: "week", y: "n",
      fill: "#2563eb", fillOpacity: 0.12, curve: "monotone-x"
    }),
    Plot.lineY(weeklyCounts, {
      x: "week", y: "n",
      stroke: "#2563eb", strokeWidth: 2.5, curve: "monotone-x"
    }),
    Plot.dot(weeklyCounts, { x: "week", y: "n", fill: "#2563eb", r: 3.5 }),
    Plot.ruleY([0])
  ]
})
